verdict.rationale: Canny's Autopilot feature explicitly captures scattered/untracked feedback automatically, and its MCP/LLM integration lets users ask about top themes and ARR impact across ideas, directly enabling AI-driven decluttering and surfacing of impactful opportunities. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of Autopilot's decluttering accuracy and no detailed docs on how impact/prioritization scoring is computed.
